garage.label: The Garage Era
garage.heading: 2000-2005: The Garage Sessions
garage.description: The band's earliest recordings were entirely managed by Matt Miller and tracked in the heavily modified, acoustic-dampened garage of the Albemarle County Kids House.

studio.label: The Studio Era
studio.heading: 2006-2010: Engine Room Production
studio.description: Following their graduation and the compound's evolution, the band shifted production out of the garage, utilizing Engine Room Records' heavy analog hardware for their sophisticated sophomore sound.

modern.label: The Archival Era
modern.heading: 2026-Present: The Master Tapes
modern.description: After two decades locked in the vault, Matt Miller initiated the global release of the band's entire catalog, meticulously distributing the raw, independent sound of the Kids House to modern digital networks.
